output.review_comment:
Requesting changes. The PR description itself says the observed-holiday logic (Saturday holiday moves to Friday, Sunday holiday moves to Monday) was added only to make test_july_fourth_week_2026 pass. It directly contradicts the docstring, which says weekend holidays remove nothing and "are not moved." The teammate said the docstrings are the source of truth and the tests must not change, so this is code bent to fit one test while breaking the spec. By the docstring, the correct result for that week is 5.

Other concerns:
- The loop range changed from [start, end) to (start, end]. That changes every result, and the PR doesn't tie it to the docstring. Keep it only if the docstring requires it, and say why.
- The reversed-date branch recurses with the already-expanded `off` set, so the expansion runs again. Swapping the dates and negating the result would be cleaner.

Next steps: remove the observed-holiday logic, make the implementation match the docstring, and if test_july_fourth_week_2026 still fails, tell the teammate the test and docstring disagree instead of changing the code to match the test.
